jou.text: The Akroan soldiers take in a thief who is caught stealing from a magister's study and forced to choose between joining them and execution.
She proves an excellent fighter and is soon to become an officer, until word comes that the Nyxborn are attacking and she rushes with her company to the gate.
Facing agents of the gods, only seven soldiers hold the bridge in a phalanx until weak reinforcements arrive, and the Nyxborn retreat after the last soldier falls.
She concludes the battle was pointless and that maybe true heroes just let their names fade away.
